A lot of people, as I say, ... sort of taking off from Malcolm X, They like a chicken bone type of ... diamond wearing, chicken eating, Cadillac driving stereotype picture. Would you describe to me your home, your family, your mother forth and father as you saw it to be, the farm and so forth. Was it poverty or was…
Well, we never went hungry. We were never hungry and ... I have seen the white people come to my parents to even borrow food ... but they would borrow something from my family.
